title: Test the endomorphism action on twist7-torsion and all eight kernels
status_note: New proposed exact symmetry diagnostic, unimplemented/unrun/unfunded. The candidate cycles are predictions from the characteristic polynomial modulo7, not recorded outcomes. Need native/GP instruments, source/spec freeze and bounded sizing.
blocked_on: note:Implement independent native/CAS instruments, freeze protocol/source/input and measure bounded sizing before execution.
question: Does the verified degree17 endomorphism induce the predicted48-point torsion cycle and8-line projective cycle on the same p827 fixture?
decision_value: All49 point images, full nonzero orbit partition and eight-kernel permutation independently verified, with controls and conditional formal matrix lemmas when feasible. Report cycles as exact finite symmetry only. Any induced map/solver claim needs explicit maps and separately charged costs; no NIST transfer or whole-IC claim.

resources.notes: Use only the archived v8 torsion basis/eight kernels and v10 certified endomorphism. Recover its2x2 action matrix overF7 from all49 points without scalar logs in the823 group. Check the characteristic polynomial, determinant/trace, matrix order, every point orbit and eight-line permutation against direct rational-map evaluations. Predicted orders48 and8 must be allowed to fail. Independent GP replay; identity/scalar matrix controls distinguish point from projective order. No assumption that a high-order finite permutation is a cheap degree1 automorphism or a new DLP attack. Prospective300s/4GiB envelope is unmeasured and grants no funded allocation.
